title: Changing a lead or a feedback message in HQ is never tested
what: No test saves a lead status or note, or a feedback status, through HQ. Nothing checks that a lead moves to Demo with its old note kept when HQ makes a gym from it, that a Won lead is never pushed back, or that the Needs you count drops after the save.
expected: A test saves a status and note on one lead and one message, reads them back, checks the other rows are untouched and the count drops, and makes a gym from a lead.
how_often: every lead and message HQ handles
fix_line: Add a server test that saves lead and feedback statuses and makes a gym from a lead

title: The 12-month promise to demo leads is tested without a Demo lead
what: The website form promises the details are deleted within 12 months. The clean-up tests use only lost, won and new leads, never one marked Demo, and no test reads the promise on the form. The Leads page also reads only the newest 300 leads and nothing tests what happens past that.
expected: The clean-up test includes an old Demo lead and checks it goes; a test reads the privacy line on the form; a test covers more than 300 leads.
fix_line: Add a Demo lead to the clean-up test and check the form privacy line

title: Nothing checks that gym owners see a changed UPI ID
what: Tests check the owner sees the UPI ID once. No test changes the details while Pay MettleUp is open or after, so an owner paying to an old UPI ID, or the trial line showing other details, would pass.
expected: A test changes the UPI ID, then checks the owner sees the new ID and QR on reopening, from Settings and from the trial line.
how_often: each time HQ changes the details
fix_line: Add a step that changes the UPI ID and reopens Pay MettleUp from both paths
